description:
This week on the podcast, we’re joined by members of the cast of Marvel Television’s Daredevil: Born Again Season 2, including Wilson Bethel, Michael Gandolfini, Matthew Lillard, Krysten Ritter, Deborah Ann Woll, and Ayelet Zurer. Plus, Marvel Comics Editor Alanna Smith helps us break down 5 essential comics to read if you’re looking for a quick introduction to Jessica Jones.   

00:00 - Welcome Back!
1:09 - Wilson Bethel, Michael Gandolfini, Matthew Lillard, Krysten Ritter, Deborah Ann Woll, and Ayelet Zurer talk DD:BA S2
26:22 - 5 essential intro comics for Jessica Jones
